resources.string: Tap to allow heart-rate access for the stress estimate
Tap to allow sensor access for skin temperature
Dashface reads the calendar synced to this watch to show your next meetings under the time. Events never leave the watch.
Dashface uses heart-rate readings the watch already takes to estimate stress. It is a wellness hint, not a medical measurement, and data never leaves the watch.
Dashface reads the watch\'s skin temperature sensor to show a thermometer under your meetings. It is a wellness hint, not a medical measurement, and data never leaves the watch.
Allow access all the time so the thermometer can update while the watch face is showing. The sensor is read once per update, at most every 15 minutes.
Allow access all the time so the estimate keeps updating while the screen is off. No extra sensor use: it only reuses readings the watch already takes.
You chose not to be asked again. You can turn access on in the app settings.
Provides next meetings, an optional stress estimate and skin temperature (on watches with the sensor) to the Dashface watch face.
Privacy: no internet access, no analytics. Calendar, heart-rate and temperature data stay on the watch.
